# Tofoo- - Independent Research Track (Phi-law / LIM)

> Canonical Role: Independent research track. Informative research only.
> Stable ID: `valo.tofoo`.
> This repository is NOT runtime source of truth. Research findings inform
> operational architecture only through an explicit adoption record in
> `nsolland/Index`.

## Architectural Boundaries

- Tofoo owns hypotheses, mathematical definitions, empirical observations,
  falsification criteria and marked implementation claims.
- Tofoo DOES NOT own runtime policy (owned by VAIG).
- Tofoo DOES NOT own clearance (owned by REHT).
- Tofoo DOES NOT own decision binding or receipts (owned by RACS).
- Tofoo DOES NOT own execution (owned by Core).
- Tofoo DOES NOT own audit receipt format, authority graph or signal thresholds.

## Epistemic Status of Claims

Each claim in `CLAIM_REGISTRY.md` carries one epistemic status:

| Status | Meaning | Location |
|---|---|---|
| hypothesis | testable proposition, not yet supported | CLAIM_REGISTRY M0-M1 |
| mathematical_definition | formally stated definition/derivation | docs/theories, M2 |
| empirical_observation | measurement on real systems | experiments, M3-M4 |
| validated_result | verified within stated architecture | experiments/constants.md, M4-M5 |
| falsification_criterion | condition that would refute the claim | docs/theories/tofoo_falsification_backlog.md |
| implementation_claim | code/mechanism exists as stated; always informative | docpack, valo-exec |

Rule: empirical does not imply replicated (M4 != M5). Unverified constants,
universal-law claims and cross-domain analogies are hypotheses until
independently supported.

## Core Files

- `repo-manifest.yaml` - machine-readable repository contract
- `CLAIM_REGISTRY.md` - claims with maturity and evidence
- `DEFINITIONS.md` - canonical terminology
- `experiments/experiment_registry.md` - experiment status (P1-P12)
- `experiments/constants.md` - constant layers and validation status
- `docs/theories/tofoo_falsification_backlog.md` - falsification conditions
